description: Configure the main staff roles and the default log channel.

content.name: staffRoles
content.description: Roles that can use basic staff commands (Shifts, LoA Request and RA Request, reviews etc.).

content.name: supervisorRoles
content.description: Roles that can manage other staff members (Approve/Deny/Manage LoA's and RA's, Manage Shifts etc.).

content.name: managementRoles
content.description: Roles with full access, including data deletion abilities.

content.name: generalLogChannel
content.description: The default channel where logs happen such as status changes/request and more. This can be overridden in some features.
